## Task

Propose a schema that records language, context, label rationale, provenance, and reviewer agreement without storing personal data.

## Done when

- [ ] The change is small, documented, and reproducible.
- [ ] Synthetic or public-domain data is used.
- [ ] The contribution states its limits and includes an example or test where relevant.

## Interested in collaborating?

Comment with your proposed approach before starting so we can keep the scope welcoming and focused.
